positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Focus: Advanced execution, project leadership, AI tooling, and repository optimization.
• Advanced Full-Stack Engineering: Build and extend complex features across Angular front ends (S3 hosted) and Java/Kotlin microservices, solving high-complexity business logic and integration challenges for high-volume retirement planning tools.
• Complex Data & AWS Cloud Integration: Manage advanced data workflows connecting Redis caching layers, managed Aurora DB instances, and external 3rd-party APIs, authoring CloudFormation templates to provision scalable ECS clusters and containerized environments.
• AI Tooling & Innovation Integration: Lead early-stage pilot initiatives ("guinea pig" tester) for emerging AI developer tools, evaluating capabilities to optimize engineering workflows and accelerate team output.
• Automated Codebase Hygiene & Branch Scanning: Designed and deployed automated branch-scanning tools to analyze repositories, prune inactive branches, reduce technical debt, and streamline CI/CD pipelines across complex codebases.
• Technical Leadership & Ownership: Stepped up to lead end-to-end execution on key initiatives, guiding cross-functional discussions, mentoring team members, and frequently delivering technical showcases to share best practices.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Focus: Optimization, testing frameworks, legacy modernization, and core execution.
• Core Financial Engine Refactoring: Maintained and optimized critical retirement calculation engines in Java/Kotlin, enhancing accuracy and system reliability for complex financial workflows.
• Frontend Integration & Modernization: Developed refreshed Angular user interfaces hosted on S3 and integrated legacy on-premise screens into modern cloud-hosted workflows for a seamless user experience.
• Caching & Performance Optimization: Diagnosed and resolved complex Redis caching issues, improving data retrieval efficiency across internal Aurora databases and external third-party API integrations.
• Testing Infrastructure & Quality: Established performance testing frameworks and expanded unit test coverage across backend services, drastically reducing regression issues during release cycles.
• AWS Cloud Maintenance: Supported multi-environment deployments using AWS ECS, EC2, and S3, ensuring stable data delivery for core retirement planning services.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +7 skills

positions.title: Software Developer / Programmer
positions.description:
• Broke down and evaluated user problems, using test scripts,
personal expertise, and probing questions.
• Worked with and coordinated the software development of
services and new software architecture
• Assisted on reported errors and bugs on newly released software
and in deployment of version relief fixes.
• Collaborated on stages of systems development lifecycle from
requirement gathering to production releases.
• Developed and Supported existing legacy code for client environments.
• Added functionality to the existing applications.
positions.insights: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Software Development and +11 skills
